checks.name: diagnostic_observed_equipment_state_evidence
checks.interpretation: Observed telemetry supports equipment-state calibration and snapshot review. The optional model-binding ledger confirms the facility-neutral normal-state model and keeps its diagnostic adapter separate from accident release. The evidence does not generate an accident, infer frequency, qualify a provider packet, or promote facility IR/F-N.

checks.name: external_native_model_contract_audit
checks.interpretation: This static audit separates native external accident export methods from PRISM-side diagnostic wrappers. It is evidence of the integration boundary, not a qualified provider packet or facility QRA.

checks.name: diagnostic_equipment_state_snapshot_binding
checks.interpretation: At least one diagnostic provider received a canonical equipment state snapshot and echoed its digest. Campaign rows without the payload remain unbound; this check does not qualify physical accuracy, frequency or facility IR/F-N.

checks.name: literature_frequency_provenance_evidence
checks.interpretation: The selected literature frequency profiles and generated event rows have source and catalogue digest provenance. This does not make the rates field-validated or create a facility credible interval.

checks.name: external_scenario_evidence_import
checks.interpretation: External procedure and failure tables are retained as facility-neutral screening evidence. Candidate families and monitoring tags do not create a frequency, provider release packet or facility IR/F-N result.

checks.name: provider_worklist_scope_alignment
checks.interpretation: The provider worklist and campaign share event IDs and primary accident families. This is a structural diagnostic check; it does not create a provider packet or qualify facility risk.
